variants.name: default
variants.what: 40 B31, mass-proportional damping alpha = 4.200, implicit dynamics dt = 5e-4, U every 0.002 s

variants.name: two_coeff
variants.what: alpha and beta for 2 % in modes 1 and 2

variants.name: plane_stress
variants.what: 2-D continuum model CPS4I 50 x 4, tip load as shear traction

variants.name: alpha_hz
variants.what: alpha = 2 zeta f with f in Hz: zeta = 0.32 %

variants.name: beta_hz
variants.what: beta = 2 zeta / f with f in Hz: zeta = 12.6 %

variants.name: general_section
variants.what: damping defined in the material, beam section integrated before the analysis (*BEAM GENERAL SECTION): the material damping is silently ignored

variants.name: quasi_static
variants.what: correct alpha, APPLICATION=QUASI-STATIC (backward Euler): numerical damping more than doubles zeta

variants.name: coarse_dt
variants.what: correct alpha, dt = 6e-3 = T/10: period elongation and too few frames

variants.name: load_not_removed
variants.what: tip force kept in the dynamic step: nothing moves

variants.name: ramp_removed
variants.what: tip force ramped down over the dynamic step: quasi-static unloading, no free vibration

variants.name: sparse_output
variants.what: correct analysis, U frames every 0.01 s

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, logarithmic decrement reported as the damping ratio
